message.content:
Based on my search, I can provide you with information about Microsoft account login issues and how to resolve them. The search results cover various login problems, error codes, and troubleshooting steps.

## Common Microsoft Account Login Issues and Solutions

### Official Microsoft Sign-In Helper
Microsoft provides a **Sign-in Helper tool** that can identify most account issues. You'll need to enter the email address or phone number you're trying to sign in with, and Microsoft will check for problems and guide you through solutions.

### Common Error Codes and Fixes

**Error 400**
- Usually means your sign-in request couldn't be processed
- Causes: Too many sign-in attempts, app/browser/device/network issues
- Solutions:
  1. Use alternative sign-in methods (face, fingerprint, PIN, security key, or email code)
  2. Update or reinstall your Microsoft app
  3. Try signing in from a different device
  4. Switch networks (Wi-Fi to mobile data or vice versa)

**Error 0x87Dd0006**
- Indicates network connectivity, permission, or account issues
- Solutions:
  1. Verify your internet connection
  2. Clear browser cache and cookies
  3. Check account credentials
  4. Update Windows and Microsoft apps
  5. Temporarily disable antivirus/firewall
  6. Try a different network

**Error 0x80048823 ("Something went wrong")**
- Causes: Incorrect credentials, account lockout, network issues, outdated software, corrupted cache, server problems, or firewall/antivirus interference
- Solutions:
  1. Verify credentials and reset password if needed
  2. Check internet connection
  3. Update Windows
  4. Check Microsoft server status
  5. Temporarily disable firewall/antivirus
  6. Clear cache (run `wsreset.exe`)
  7. Check system date/time settings
  8. Use Microsoft Account Troubleshooter

**Error 0x8019001**
- Related to Windows installation/update sign-in issues
- Solutions: Check credentials, verify network connectivity, repair Windows installation, update drivers/software

### Account Recovery Options

If you can't sign in at all:
- **Forgot password**: Use the [password reset page](https://account.live.com/password/reset)
- **Forgot email/username**: Use the account lookup tool
- **Account locked or suspended**: Fill out the [Account Recovery Form](https://account.live.com/acsr) or the Account Reinstatement Form
- **Account not recognized**: Use the Sign-in Helper tool

### Windows Profile Issues

If you see "We can't sign in to your account" or get signed in with a temporary profile:
1. Restart in safe mode and sign in with your original profile
2. Restart normally and try again (may need multiple restarts)
3. Temporarily disable antivirus software
4. Disable Windows Defender services temporarily
5. Create a new local administrator account and copy your data

### Recent Windows 11 Sign-In Bug (March 2026)

Microsoft released an out-of-band update **KB5085516** for Windows 11 versions 24H2 and 25H2 to fix a critical sign-in bug where users with Microsoft accounts incorrectly received a "no Internet" error during authentication, blocking access to apps like Teams Free and OneDrive.

---

If you're experiencing a specific login issue, please provide more details about:
- The exact error message or code you're seeing
- Whether this is on Windows, a web browser, or a specific app
- Whether it's a personal or work/school account

This will help me provide more targeted assistance.

Sources:
1. https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accounts-billing/manage/i-can-t-sign-in-to-my-microsoft-account
2. https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/account-billing/error-400-when-signing-in-7af27146-7624-4397-a374-6f8eae4367fe
3. https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accounts-billing/manage/error-400-when-signing-in
4. https://cybersecuritynews.com/windows-11-account-sign-in-failure/
5. https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accounts-billing/manage/my-username-and-password-have-stopped-working
6. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/answers/questions/5612408/error-code-50089-when-login-to-microsoft-account
7. https://umatechnology.org/error-0x87dd0006-when-trying-to-login-to-my-microsoft-account-in/
8. https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/-we-can-t-sign-in-to-your-account-error-message-3e08c5c8-92cc-48dc-80a4-f66d072c6edb
9. https://umatechnology.org/microsoft-account-login-error-code-0x80048823-something-went-wrong/
10. https://answers.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/forum/all/login-is-not-working-for-my-microsoft-account/f52906b1-85ed-4dca-a49b-3130675daa3a
